_note: Top dogs that challenge Brownie to a turn-based duel (`topdog <x> <y> <id>` in a room file). hp/attack/defense are battle stats; moves are picked at random each turn from the list (repeat a move to make it likelier): bite, growl (lowers Brownie's attack), howl (heals, only when hurt), pounce (crouches one turn, then hits twice as hard). reward = TT$ for winning, xp = what Brownie learns. Conversations: intro (before the duel), win/lose (after), after (talking to them once beaten). Names and lines are drafts.
